{{Use dmy dates|date=April 2022}}
'''Peter Thrower''' (born 1938) is a [[professor emeritus]] of [[materials science]] and [[engineering]] at  [[Pennsylvania State University]],<ref>[http://www.matse.psu.edu/faculty_acd/emeritus Emeritus faculty listing] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20101222041417/http://www.matse.psu.edu/faculty_acd/emeritus |date=2010-12-22 }}, Materials Science & Engineering, Penn State University, retrieved 2011-02-18.</ref> and a former [[editor-in-chief]] of the [[scientific journal]] ''[[Carbon (journal)|Carbon]]'',<ref>[http://www.elsevier.com/wps/find/journaleditorialboard.cws_home/258/editorialboard ''Carbon'' editorial board], Elsevier, retrieved 2011-02-18.</ref> a post he has held between 1982 and 2013. A special issue of ''[[Carbon (journal)|Carbon]]'' was published in his honor in August 2012.<ref>[http://www.sciencedirect.com/science/journal/00086223/50/9 Festschrift dedicated to Peter A. Thrower, Editor-in-Chief, 1972 – 2012]. sciencedirect.com</ref> He also edited the review journal ''[[Chemistry and Physics of Carbon]]'' from 1973 to 1998.<ref name="cw">[http://www.elsevierscitech.com/conferences/carbon/workshop/speakers.html Speaker biography] from Carbon Journal Workshop on Carbon Materials for Energy Storage and Generation, retrieved 2011-02-18.</ref> He is a specialist on [[carbon]] in all its forms.

Thrower studied physics at the [[University of Cambridge]]. He then took up a position at the [[Atomic Energy Research Establishment]] (Harwell, UK) before moving to Pennsylvania State University, where he remained until he retired in 1998.<ref name="cw"/>
